Collagen supplements are not automatically useless. But they are often oversold. Oral collagen is broken down into amino acids and collagen-derived peptides. Some studies show modest improvements in hydration, elasticity, and barrier measures — but the evidence is mixed, product-dependent, and influenced by study quality and funding. What collagen powder does not do: It does not travel directly to your face. It does not replace lost facial volume. It does not erase wrinkles like filler. It does not replace sunscreen, retinoids, protein, or a real skin plan. Think of collagen powder like sending lumber to a construction site. Helpful if the site is ready. But lumber alone does not build the house. Protect what you have. Signal what you want to rebuild. Plan before powder. Comment COLLAGEN for the checklist. Educational only.
